column1: # Game profile of The Legend of Zelda: Echoes of Wisdom (Switch, base game 1.0.0 = v0, a cartridge dump). Plays on the iPad; on the Mac: the title, file select and about 4 minutes of play, at 60 fps with sound

# Grezzo's engine on NintendoWare (G3d / Ui2d / Vfx / Atk / Font), as Link's Awakening, SDK 16.2.0, NVN; modules main + subsdk0 (GLSLC, the runtime shader compiler) + subsdk1 (NintendoSDK_movie) + sdk.
# RomFS (10,963 files, 7.48 GB): bfres models and maps (region_common/map, region_common/actor), shaders in region_common/shader/*.bfsha (BNSH), particle effects in region_common/effect/*.ptcl,
# layouts in region_common/ui/*.arc (SARC), movies in region_common/movie/*.webm. The provisional profile's guesses held: no host or rewriter change

# Game name: only a label for profile listings and the Mac window title; the iOS app name is the game name in the base NSP, and the bundle ID comes from the base game title ID (build_ipa.sh / NSP script)

column1: # the base game is a cartridge dump (.xci) with no ticket; no update was brought up
# The NPDM declares no system resource, so the game has no virtual address memory: it sets a heap of 3.11 GB and allocates from it.
# The block is 256 MB in front + 256 MB alias region + 256 MB stack region + 3.25 GB heap region
# the NPDM declares no system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon
# shader_* keys are in every shader's cache key: the groups and the note are the provisional profile's, kept so that its shader libraries stay valid
